Standard Hopf theory therefore gives a stable small cycle for sufficiently small positive \\(a\\). value.rationale: The source labels a central local bifurcation as codimension-two Hopf-zero, but the printed equations give an ordinary Hopf with only a two-dimensional center. Correcting this changes the normal-form class and supplies a concrete, stable small-periodic-orbit prediction on the positive-\\(a\\) side. The exact \\(l_1\\) formula also identifies the nonlinear criticality boundary for the whole \\(b,c,d>0\\) family, so the result is structurally meaningful rather than a cosmetic eigenvalue correction.
